nodes.name: coin toss and half-start kickoffs
nodes.notes: seeded toss; the winner's choice; half-start kickoffs validated by `validate_half_start`

nodes.name: kickoff and safety free kick
nodes.notes: **one unconditional draw** of (spot, runoff) from the pool; no onside decision, no score or clock conditioning; the pool keeps only kickoffs after which the receiving team runs the next play, so onside recoveries, kick-return touchdowns and kickoff turnovers cannot occur; no guard for an empty pool (`random.choice` raises); halts `safety_free_kick_not_modelled`

nodes.name: drive
nodes.notes: play loop below; a halt in E1 blocks the game

nodes.name: penalty check
nodes.notes: the pool excludes penalties; a sampled penalty row blocks `penalty_not_modelled`

nodes.name: two-minute warning
nodes.notes: clock stop at 2:00 in Q2 and Q4, also applied to kickoffs

nodes.name: participants for stats
nodes.notes: maps the sampled row's participants and the pre-snap choices to the simulated players for statistics

nodes.name: timeouts
nodes.notes: **not a decision**: a timeout happens only when the sampled row had one, charged to the mapped team; once a team has none, the guard removes timeout rows from the cell; halts `timeout_team_unresolved`, `timeout_limit_exceeded`, `timeout_sampling_guard_mismatch`, H2

nodes.name: field goal result
nodes.notes: make/miss from `kicks['field_goal']` by bucket unless the row carries the result; halts `thin_kick_cell`, `field_goal_outcomes_missing`, distance-model halts

nodes.name: try after touchdown
nodes.notes: overtime uses the conditional overtime table (`conditional_try_fallback`)

nodes.name: observed overtime drive
nodes.notes: **dead code**: defined, never called. The overtime drive pool only switches overtime on (`_regulation_over`, line 811)

nodes.name: overtime
nodes.notes: Rule 16: seeded toss, observed kick-or-receive model, 10-minute period, overtime timeouts; drives are played play by play with the regulation pool and `OVERTIME_FOURTH_DOWN_KICK_SHARE` at 4th down; possession and sudden-death rules in `_overtime_possession`, `_sudden_death_touchdown`

nodes.conditioning: `pre_event.choose`: participation-field lineup and personnel, formation prior, coverage prior, QB decision (`qb_decisions.draw`: scramble with its own support ladder exact 10 / down-field 25 / down-distance 25 / field-zone 50 / league; target role shrunk to a prior; QB run-role style, min support 20), decision labels, Dirichlet player shares
